page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores and 40 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.8 GB of memory per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average tier across several performance vectors. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1438.99, while multi-core performance reaches 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 2133.36 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. In application-specific workloads, the instance achieves a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec and processes 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the system handles 135M parameter LLM prompt processing at 1841.39 tokens per second and text generation at 76.66 tokens per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer stable resource density for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of GPU accelerators or local NVMe storage. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale block storage independently. This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and moderate-scale text or image processing tasks.
